name: Shiphron
title: Son of Gad
summary: Shiphron was one of the sons of Gad, who was a son of Jacob and Zilpah. He was among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob's family. He is the ancestor of one of the clans within the tribe of Gad.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the descendants of Jacob
keyEvents.description: Sifjon is mentioned as one of Gad's sons in the list of Jacob's descendants who traveled to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Sifjon was among the seventy people in Jacob's household who went down to Egypt during the famine, where Joseph already held a position of power.

keyEvents.title: The Clan of Sifjon
keyEvents.description: In the census on the plains of Moab, Sifjon's clan (the Ziphionites) is mentioned as part of the tribe of Gad.

keyEvents.title: Gad's Sons in Exodus
keyEvents.description: Sifjon is also mentioned in the list of Israel's sons who came to Egypt, in connection with the enumeration of Gad's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Family Settles in Goshen
keyEvents.description: As part of Jacob's extended family, Sifjon settled in the land of Goshen in Egypt, where the Israelites grew into a great nation.
